items.project: RTC Maryland Parkway BRT RED LINE
items.location: Maryland Parkway corridor: South Strip Transit Terminal to Las Vegas Medical District, via UNLV area, Bonneville Transit Center and airport connection
items.status: Scheduled to launch Aug 23, 2026 with systemwide service change (per Fox5 Aug 4 preview; launch not confirmed by a post-launch source). Overall project completion slated fall 2026.
items.dateConfidence: launch date reported in advance; actual launch and project completion unconfirmed
items.summary: ~12.5-mile BRT line replacing Route 109, dedicated lanes, 12-minute daytime frequency 7 days, hydrogen fuel cell buses, enhanced stations. $378M project, $150M federal grant.
items.whyItMatters: Changes how residents get between the airport area, UNLV, downtown and the medical district without a car; durable 'how to ride' search value.
items.recommendedAngle: Riding the Maryland Parkway RED LINE: is it worth it? FILM: ride-along and station walkthrough on public transit.
verifiedFacts: Fox5 Aug 4 2026: RED LINE replaces Route 109, 12-min daytime frequency, hydrogen buses, links to Bonneville Transit Center, South Strip Transit Terminal, airport
